summary: The delegated execution stack (BUILD-AUTOMATION-002 → BUILD-FLOFI-UNIVERSAL-SINGLE-AUTH-MAINNET-001, PR #166) is a generic, PostgreSQL-fenced executor (apps/reference-dapp/src/delegation/executor.ts) that drives one `delegated_executions` row per source — an automation occurrence (`executeOccurrence`) or a conversational workflow run (`executeWorkflowRun`) — through QUEUED → AUTHORITY_VERIFIED → RESERVED → RUNNING → SETTLED, with each step going PENDING → SIMULATED → POLICY_VERIFIED → SUBMISSION_PREPARED → SUBMITTED → RECONCILED via a per-mechanism StepDriver (drivers.ts). Authority is an ERC-7710 delegation (MetaMask Delegation Framework v1.3.0) signed by the owner's EIP-7702 MetaMask smart account, in two shapes: a reusable class-scoped Credential grant (passkey-anchored, authorized per workflow by ONE WebAuthn assertion over a UniversalWorkflowAuthorization envelope) or, for workflow runs, an exact "workflow grant" per EVM chain (ExactCalldata + IdEnforcer per call, Redeemer = the executor, signed with eth_signTypedData_v4; no passkey) compiled in workflow-grants.ts. In EVERY EVM path the on-chain sender and gas payer is the executor session address: `signEvmCalls` (drivers.ts:98-128) builds EIP-1559 transactions with `from = ctx.grant.sessionAddress`, `to = DelegationManager`, signs the digest with `SignerUser.signEvmDigest` (AWS KMS in production, kms-signer.ts:171-184) and broadcasts via `eth_sendRawTransaction` on the 'executor' transport (chains.ts:22, drivers.ts:164); the runbook (docs/deploy/SINGLE-AUTH-MAINNET-ACTIVATION.md:49-54) explicitly says "The executor sends every redemption, so it pays the gas on each chain" and asks the owner to fund EXECUTOR with ETH. The Solana path exists only as a MOCKED harness driver whose fee payer is also the session key (drivers.ts:416); the KMS provider refuses Solana signing (kms-signer.ts:185) and `stepCapability` refuses production Solana (capabilities.ts:76). Nonces for the shared KMS address are allocated per (chain, sessionAddress) under `pg_advisory_xact_lock` inside `prepareSubmission` (pg-store.ts:559-567), seeded from `max(evm_next_nonce)` across grants (`sessionNextNonce`, pg-store.ts:575-579; executor.ts:342-343) and `eth_getTransactionCount(session,'pending')` (drivers.ts:100-101); stale never-sent submissions are neutralized with executor-paid zero-value self-transactions (`fillStaleNonces`, drivers.ts:134-150). Reconciliation is receipt-based: the last receipt must carry exactly one `RedeemedDelegation(owner, sessionAddress)` log plus the exact ERC-20 Transfer legs (drivers.ts:196-200, 270-280, 353-369); never-mined txs whose nonce was consumed are reported as failed calls (`nonceConsumed`, drivers.ts:177-182). A workflow run mirrors its one execution in workflow-runs/runner.ts:194-232 (SETTLED→COMPLETED etc.). Configuration is fail-closed in config.ts: FLOFI_DELEGATION, FLOFI_DELEGATED_SIGNER (none|aws-kms|local-disposable|memory|remote-api), FLOFI_DELEGATED_EXECUTION, FLOFI_DELEGATION_MAINNET_CHAINS, FLOFI_DELEGATION_RPC_<id>, FLOFI_KMS_REGION/FLOFI_KMS_EVM_KEY_ARN; the signing half (`SignerUser`) is handed only to the executor worker (executor-runtime.ts:16-23), enforced by boundaries.test.ts. Nothing in this subsystem implements EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls, ERC-4337 UserOperations, pre-signed user transactions or Solana signAllTransactions/durable nonces (greps over apps/reference-dapp/src and packages found no such code paths outside a provider test list and i18n copy), and no "gas payer must be the user" invariant exists anywhere in the delegated path; the only gas-payer evidence in the codebase is the owner-signed public flows' `receipt.gasPayer` / OWNER_SUBMISSION_RELAYED_FEE_PAID_BY_RELAYER finding (server/public-testnet-service.ts:1499,1573), which the delegated drivers' evidence does not record.

FAILURE/RECOVERY: broadcast failure → step UNCERTAIN, execution UNCERTAIN (enterUncertain 426), SUBMISSION_STALE triggers fillStaleNonces (drivers.ts:134-150: executor-signed, executor-paid zero-value self-tx at each never-seen nonce); PENDING reconcile re-broadcasts the persisted bytes only (390-394); REVERTED → settleBudget(spent)+release → FAILED or HALTED(attention) if an earlier step reconciled; owner executionResume (service.ts:712-725) HALTED→RUNNING and re-enqueues; sweep re-arms idle executions (executor-runtime.ts:57-63).

risks: Removing the executor as sender invalidates the whole ERC-7710 redemption model (Redeemer/delegate = executor): a half-migration where workflow grants are still collected but user-funded submission is used would leave signed delegations that authorize the executor address for nothing, or worse, both paths live. Decide explicitly whether ERC-7710 grants survive (e.g. only for scheduled automations) or are retired for runs.

Fail-closed gating must be enforced below the driver layer (prepareSubmission / chains.ts allowlist / DB trigger), because executor.ts is generic and will happily persist and broadcast any `submission` a driver returns.

Pre-signed exact user artifacts (UserOps, EIP-1559 txs) fix calldata at signing: dependent amounts must stay 'signed guaranteed minimum' (workflow-grants.ts:108-119) or use on-chain balance-reading helpers; estimated amounts cannot be pre-signed honestly. Pre-signed raw EIP-1559 txs from the user EOA also freeze fees and sequential nonces and are fragile under fee spikes or any intervening user tx.

Nonce model: the advisory-lock allocation (pg-store.ts:559-565) is keyed on the executor; user-signed UserOps need EntryPoint 2D nonce keys per chain and reconciliation via eth_getUserOperationReceipt; wallet_sendCalls needs wallet_getCallsStatus polling with the wallet as broadcaster — reconciliation's RedeemedDelegation assertion (drivers.ts:197-200) must be replaced per kind.

KMS key remains funded with ETH per the runbook; after the change the balance and the Sign permission become attack surface with no purpose — rotation/decommission steps and the `delegation.worker_enabled` executor-address logging need revisiting.

boundaries.test.ts, migration CHECK constraints (mechanism/state enums, submission non-null), and schema-compatibility certificates (docs/deploy/RELEASE-SINGLE-AUTH-0021-0022.md) will all break on new mechanisms/kinds — expect a migration 0023 and certificate updates.

Solana first-class needs a production signer path for the owner only (signAllTransactions in the browser); any server-side Solana key (KMS Ed25519) would recreate the gas-payer problem; durable nonces require nonce accounts the user funds and a nonce-advance reconciliation.
